title: Tele-Rehabilitation Intervention in Community-Based Healthcare for Patients With Parkinson's Disease (DHEAL-COM-PD)
official: Tele-Rehabilitation Intervention in Community-Based Healthcare for Patients With Parkinson's Disease (DHEAL-COM-PD)
summary: The study aims to measure the improvement in functional capacity in a group of elderly people suffering from early-stage Parkinson's disease (Hoehn \& Yahr scale 1-3), following a telerehabilitation intervention integrated with BTS TELEREHAB technology.
sponsor: Istituto Nazionale di Ricovero e Cura per Anziani
